card.name: The word time after the
card.fires_on: The word "time" (and sometimes "when") right after "the", "a" or "keep", where it introduces a point or period in time. Seen in general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: time after the/a
modes.description: The noun "time" follows an article and starts a phrase about a period or moment.
modes.example: The manufacture of these chemicals requires vast quantities of fossil fuels at a<< time>> when those costs are at a premium.

modes.label: when as a question word
modes.description: The word "when" asks about the moment something happened.
modes.example: Ibrahìm asked her<< when>> this had happened, and if she thought
